premises.statement: D1 admission authenticates exact Core, Protocol, profile, module, algorithm, and contract bytes before projection.
B5B2's schema grammar does not itself issue a view body for the D1 authority; only D1 project_public_coin is treated as realized.

rendering_rules.rule: each Core occurrence renders as exactly one do-block construct in Core order
each construct claims exactly one active view leaf, or one typed no_source_coordinate gap
the shared Challenge is sampled once and the resulting value is passed to both consuming Reductions
joint member 2 receives exactly the prior joint member 1; the group and index remain separately ledgered
Oracle mode and query visibility are parameters unless an issued EffectView leaf determines them
Accept, then Abort, then fallback Reject render as nested first-active branches
